name: pi-wielder-spike
description: Pi-Wielder spike: one wallet pays per-call x402 for model inference and hosted Skill Invocations; the Collar journal is authoritative and the Wielder keeps a signed-receipt view. Testnet-only (Base Sepolia); fully offline in mock mode.

scripts.test:kernel: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/kernel-*.test.mjs tests/wallet-*.test.mjs tests/eip3009-exact.test.mjs tests/x402-v2-transport.test.mjs tests/base-sepolia-observer.test.mjs tests/seller-evidence-resolver.test.mjs tests/config.test.mjs tests/projection-exporter.test.mjs tests/agent-*.test.mjs tests/operator-*.test.mjs tests/spend-control-proxy.test.mjs tests/control-plane.test.mjs
scripts.verify:spend-control: npm test && npm run e2e && npm run e2e:spend-control
